message_lifespan.description: The maximum timestamp span to be fused.

approximate_sync.description: Whether to work in Approximate Synchronization Mode.

prior_log_odds.description: The uniform prior log-odds to initialize the belief for any new traffic light state. 0.0 (log(1)) means a neutral (50%) initial belief. Positive values make all states initially more likely, negative values make them less likely.

enable.description: Enables the validation feature. If set to true, the system checks for consistency among detected traffic light signals associated with a specific regulatory element.

publish_partial_matched_signal.description: Determines whether to publish common signals among traffic lights associated with a regulatory element. If set to true, partially matched signals will be published. If set to false, a single mismatch among the traffic lights will output a fail-safe signal.

fusion_mode.description: Fusion algorithm. 'stateset' (default) is the legacy StateKey-level Bayesian fusion. 'per_element' enables per-(color,shape) Bayesian fusion with mutex-group conflict resolution; in that mode signal_consistency_check.* is ignored.

on_threshold.description: Output an element when its accumulated log-odds exceed this threshold. Only used when fusion_mode is 'per_element'.

confidence_gate.description: Drop classifier detections whose confidence is below this gate before they accumulate any evidence. Only used when fusion_mode is 'per_element'.

strict_mode.description: When true, an unresolved mutex conflict produces a failsafe UNKNOWN output for the entire group. When false, the conflict is resolved by keeping the argmax element. Only used when fusion_mode is 'per_element'.
